output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals), which can overflow if initialSupply is large enough.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_from] -= _value; can underflow if _value is larger than balanceOf[_from], causing it to wrap around and become a very large value, allowing attackers to increase their balance.
The transfer function calls the _transfer function, which has an integer overflow vulnerability. If _value is large enough, it can cause an overflow, allowing attackers to increase their balance.
The transferFrom function calls the _transfer function, which has an integer overflow vulnerability. If _value is large enough, it can cause an overflow, allowing attackers to increase their balance.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. If _value is large enough, it can cause an overflow, allowing attackers to increase their allowance.
